subject: Dispute - invoice INV-2026-104233 overcharge
body:
Dear AD Ports Finance,

We dispute invoice INV-2026-104233. Our UCID is UC100245.
The storage charges were billed at the wrong tariff: we were overcharged by AED 6,400.00 (14 days billed instead of 7).

Disputed amount: AED 6,400.00
Reason: overcharge on storage days.

Regards,
Accounts team
Gulf Star Shipping LLC
